secondary.use: Codex lane for clear-spec execution, independent review, computer use, and token-heavy mechanical work.

hard.selection: Use the smallest effort that clears the context-ablation quality gate.

ultra.use: Independent lanes only; never silently create an agent team.

claude-opus-5-5.effort_selection: Use the lowest effort that clears the versioned context-ablation quality gate.

gpt-6-sol.effort_selection: Use the lowest effort that clears the versioned context-ablation quality gate.
gpt-6-sol.unavailable: Use gpt-6-astra at high and name the fallback; never a cheaper GPT model.

gpt-6-astra.effort_selection: Use the lowest effort that clears the versioned context-ablation quality gate.

claude-fable-5-1.effort_selection: Use the lowest effort that clears the versioned context-ablation quality gate.

selection.fallback: Keep one owner. A different-family pass requires explicit delegation.
selection.promotion_rule: Promote a model, effort, or context variant only after it passes the versioned ablation gate.

api_only.pro_mode: Available through the API; do not imply that a local CLI session uses it.
api_only.persistence_and_ptc: Use persisted reasoning or programmatic tool calling only in an API harness that exposes them.
api_only.explicit_prompt_cache: Use only in API integrations that expose cache controls.
